entities.summary: Jalen Armand Reagor is an American professional football wide receiver and return specialist. He played college football for the TCU Horned Frogs and was selected by the Philadelphia Eagles in the first round of the 2020 NFL draft. He has also played for the Minnesota Vikings and New England Patriots.
